digest.component_or_area: store push and init (S3 remote preflight)
propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket-store remote without a git-remote-s3 helper (version >=0.3.2) causes silent store corruption by writing multiple bundles for one ref, and today rebar does not prevent this misconfiguration until corruption occurs

Store init and synchronous push paths must detect S3 mode by remote URL scheme and call require_s3_helper() before any push attempt, raising OptionalDependencyError unconditionally (independent of strict flag) to fail closed with an actionable message naming pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' and the >=0.3.2 minimum

The S3 preflight is keyed only off the already-resolved remote URL (s3:// or s3+zip://) with no new config key or URL-resolution seam added; existing git remote get-url calls at push.py:418 and init.py are reused
With a non-S3-scheme remote or an unresolvable remote, the preflight must be a no-op and existing best-effort behavior (including remote-not-found skip) must be preserved
